$comment: Initial Indonesian (id) content rows. M2's seedTemplate() PUTs each one to Kontena's authoring API: PUT /projects/{projId}/content/single/{schemaSlug}?locale=id. Placeholders in {{DOUBLE_BRACES}} are substituted at provisioning time from the job config (e.g. SITE_NAME from the wizard).
